expiry: The code is valid for {minutes} minutes and works once.
tagline: An arcade in your browser: one account, scores and leaderboards.
automated: This message was sent automatically; there is no need to reply.

verification.subject: Your PLAYNEX verification code: {code}
verification.preheader: Enter this code within {minutes} minutes to open your account.
verification.heading: Welcome to the arcade
verification.intro: Enter the code below on the sign-up screen to open your account. Once it is in, your profile is ready and you can start playing.
verification.ignore: If you did not start this sign-up, you can ignore this email; the account stays closed until it is verified.

passwordReset.subject: Your PLAYNEX password reset code: {code}
passwordReset.preheader: Enter this code within {minutes} minutes to set a new password.
passwordReset.heading: Set a new password
passwordReset.intro: A password reset was requested for your account. Enter the code below on the reset screen and choose a new password. Changing it signs you out on your other devices.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.

signIn.subject: Your PLAYNEX sign-in code: {code}
signIn.preheader: Enter this code within {minutes} minutes to finish signing in.
signIn.heading: Is this you signing in?
signIn.intro: Someone is signing in to your account with the correct password. Enter the code below on the sign-in screen to finish.
signIn.ignore: If this was not you, do not share the code and change your password; no session opens without it.
